messages.author: 5140016d70f6ba82
messages.subject: Re: New user, I need Help
parts:
It sounds to me that you should be using capture-recapture models rather
than distance sampling. You may want to look at some of the spatially
explicit models like Density
(http://www.landcareresearch.co.nz/services/software/density/). --jeff

On 3/3/2010 5:59 PM, Victor Luja wrote:
> > Hi all
> >
> > I am a new Distance user. I am working with 4 treefrog populations in Baja, Mexico. I have
> > data of raw abundances. My sampling design is 3 transects x 21 months on each 4 oases.
> >
> > I used a removal sampling design (i.e., removed individuals that were captured and
> > released them only at the end of the third night of sampling). I need to know if it would be
> > possible to use removal sampling analyses to estimate abundance corrected for detection
> > probability using Distance.
> >
> > Thanks
> >
> > VHL
> >
> > --
> > distance-sampling list home page:

> >
